clauses.title: Scope – Requirements, and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements, and the methods of sampling and test for  putty for use in fixing glass panes on wood and metal frames and for filling splits, cracks and holes in wood or metal.

clauses.title: Form and Condition –
clauses.text: 2.1 Form and Condition -  Shall be homogeneous paste and shall be free from grit and other visible impurities.

clauses.title: Composition – Shall consist
clauses.text: 2.2 Composition -  Shall consist of mainly whiting and linsed oil, if necessary, varnish and suitable additives.

clauses.title: The calcium carbonate content of extracted
clauses.text: 2.2.1 The calcium carbonate content of extracted pigment, from putty, shall be not less than 80 percent.

clauses.title: Consistency – The material,
clauses.text: 2.3 Consistency - The material, after thorough working in hands, shall have good plastic quality without sliminess or stickness that would render it difficult to handle and apply. It shall work readily and smoothly under a palette knife without crumbling or cracking. After being moulded in place, it shall convert itself into a cohesive mass which will not yield to specified pressure after 72 hours.

clauses.title: The material shall also
